footnotes.english: I do, however, acknowledge that serious introverts likely need more peace, quiet, and alone time than most people and might benefit from a quieter environment, if not their own office.
footnotes.chinese: 不过，我也承认，性格非常内向的人可能比大多数人更需要安宁、静谧和独处的时间。即使没有独立办公室，更安静的环境也可能对他们有益。
footnotes.after: 我认为，对大多数工程师而言，独立办公室不仅没有必要，甚至相当危险。

footnotes.english: This is incredibly difficult if you’ve been burned in the past by delegating to incompetent people.
footnotes.chinese: 如果你过去曾因把工作交给不称职的人而吃过亏，做到这一点就会格外困难。
footnotes.after: 你相信他人有能力，也会做正确的事，并且愿意在适当的时候让他们主导。

footnotes.english: You can find a dozen variants of this legend on the web, attributed to different famous managers.

footnotes.english: By the same token, if you do the same thing over and over and keep failing, it’s not failure, it’s incompetence.
footnotes.chinese: 同样的道理，如果你一次又一次地做同样的事情，却不断失败，那不是失败，而是无能。
footnotes.after: 失败是学习的宝贵机会，能帮助我们在下次尝试时做得更好。
